title: primula odontocalyx
intro: Primula odontocalyx, commonly known as "Mountain Primrose", is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Primula odontocalyx include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
